messages.content: Ongoing: RoboRide launches autonomous ride-share service in Millfield. Price: $0.18 per mile. Average wait time: 15 minutes. Cove

Auto sector revenue index: 79 (baseline: 100). Foot traffic and sales are somewhat down.

You Attend the scheduled meeting with Kevin O'Brien at the bank. Walk in with prepared numbers: estimated installation cost $8,000–$15,000 for two Level 2 EV chargers, existing electrical infrastructure on the parcel, ChargePoint/Blink revenue-share offset model. Get real loan terms — rate, duration, monthly payment — and assess whether a 5-year capital improvement loan at current rates pencils out given the revenue trajectory. Do not commit today. Come out with a written term sheet and a clear decision framework.. Savings dropped by $951.
